text.content:
A quiet alcove off the main pens, its ceiling low enough that even a goblin has to stoop. Someone dragged in a genuinely comfortable chair from somewhere and it's been fought over ever since - the current occupant has fallen asleep mid-argument, one hand still raised to make a point.

GM Notes

Clue: Overheard here (from the sleep-talker, or from anyone the party asks): the Larders, past Room 6, used to be exactly that - larders. Now it's equal parts throne room and petting zoo, and none of the goblins nominally in charge of the change can explain how or when it happened. It simply accreted, the way these things do around something like Buttercup.

Rest use: Safe to use as an actual rest area if the party clears or bribes its way past the sleeper - who does not want to fight, only to finish the nap.
